statements.text: I’ve introduced the Candidate Voice Fraud Prohibition Act to regulate the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in U.S. elections and urge my colleagues to support this measure for the sake of our free and fair democratic system.

The threat that AI poses in our elections is severe and real. Period.

It’s a danger that can lead to misinformation, spread deepfakes, and cause serious harm to our democracy. 

We must stop it before it’s too late. https://t.co/pj5wWaqkKv

Heading back to NY-13 after another week in Washington:
 
✔️Fought to fund the National Latino Museum

✔️ Introduced a bill to curb Artificial Intelligence (AI) in elections

✔️ Stood against MAGA efforts to cut climate funds

✔️ Successfully protected passenger data on flights https://t.co/SopPsDZkvo

Thank you @CNN Fredricka Whitfield for having me on today to discuss my new bill regulating Artificial Intelligence (AI) in elections. 

AI-generated political ads are here, and we must avert misinformation. https://t.co/6hnXMV1aM0

Let me be clear: AI shouldn’t interfere with our free and fair democratic process.

I introduced the ‘Candidate Voice Prohibition Act’ to control the amount of misinformation coming out of election deep fakes.

We must govern and regulate AI before it’s too late! https://t.co/0aJkXGnsmY

The prevalence of AI is constantly increasing in the daily lives of Americans. However, there are very few laws currently in place to limit this powerful technology and its use to replicate with impressive accuracy, the voice, facial expressions, and mannerisms of politically engaged individuals or those seeking elected office.
statements.venue: Riverdale Press, on Candidate Voice Fraud Prohibition Act

statements.text: Unchecked AI usage in political communications has the potential to lead to unprecedented manipulation and misinformation, limiting the ability of the public to decipher between facts and fiction in the political arena, while interfering with free and fair elections and the future of American democracy.
statements.venue: Riverdale Press, on Candidate Voice Fraud Prohibition Act

statements.text:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is here to stay and we’ve witnessed its impact on our workforce, labor market, and the American people.

I commend @POTUS for today’s actions on the use of this technology to ensure safety, accountability, security, and trust.

https://t.co/qXEJZGjzQt

Proud to join Vice Chair @RepTedLieu for yesterday's AI roundtable to address equity and inclusive rollout of this new technology.

The journey to shape a responsible and inclusive AI landscape persists, propelled by discussions and insights from meaningful events such as this. https://t.co/mLFPoV6PbH

How can we ensure that AI is fair, inclusive, and accountable? I was excited to discuss this question and more in my latest op-ed with @RPLNYC for @NYDailyNews. 

My 2 pieces of legislation on AI, H.Res.649 and H.R. 4611, also aim to ensure equitable practices in this new era. https://t.co/qgZt6llGT8
statements.quoted: New #AI systems are being deployed without ethical guardrails, but the U.S. has an opportunity to lead internationally by investing in responsible technological development now. @RepEspaillat and @RPLNYC lay it out in a @NYDailyNews op-ed: https://t.co/MP9enc8jh5 https://t.co/SCmuV9M2qY

statements.text: Despite this, Congress has yet to act on regulating automated systems.
statements.venue: NY Daily News op-ed co-authored with Rose Pierre-Louis (reposted by McSilver Institute)

Artificial intelligence (AI) holds incredible promises, but it is also important to address its challenges. By ensuring diverse representation and voices in #AI development, the @HispanicCaucus is leading efforts to create a more just and equitable AI future.

This inaugural roundtable is a significant step toward ensuring that AI development benefits all communities, particularly those that have been underserved. AI has the potential to revolutionize our society, but it must be developed and implemented responsibly.

statements.text:
New  Yorkers are feeling the squeeze from skyrocketing energy bills, which  can be attributed to corporate greed, data centers, AI, and Trump’s  insane policies on tariffs and renewable energy projects.

We cannot rely on the market forces or existing authorities to rectify this problem — and everyday Americans need relief now.

I  wrote a letter to @SpeakerJohnson urging him to use the power of his  position and the GOP majority to design and advance frameworks for the  federal government to regulate — and freeze — the ballooning utility  rates, which are straining families, individuals, and small businesses alike.

There is no reason AI should be a partisan issue. 

We must work across the aisle to harness its benefits while putting the right safeguards in place to protect workers, consumers, and our communities. https://t.co/LKIQ9jPxeH
